head: Capture. Focus. Reset. is a calm daily planner app for iPhone
dek: Capture. Focus. Reset. is a new 3-dollar iPhone and iPad app for planning your day: you pick the few priorities that matter and leave the rest on a master list. Each day ends with a short review and a plan for tomorrow.
details: Every task you finish adds a star to a sky in the app. It's made by Peaceful Sea Productions and has been out since 24 November. It was 63rd among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 26 November.
means: If long to-do lists stress you out, this planner keeps only a few tasks in front of you each day.
todo: It costs 3 dollars on the App Store; read the listing first to see whether it fits how you plan.
